result.target_topic: Marketable Equity Securities Valuation and Results
result.target_summary: Marketable equity securities, primarily publicly traded, were valued at $225 million as of January 28, 2024, with no significant net unrealized or realized gains reported for fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation: No counterpart was found in 2023. The 2024 disclosure focuses on Marketable equity securities valuations ($225M) and lack of significant gains/losses. The 2023 search did not identify a disclosure with this specific focus on marketable equity securities fair values and gains/losses in Note 8 or similar sections that would constitute a direct topic match. The 2023 D053/D054 were about Mellanox acquisition accounting. Thus, this is a single-sided 2024 disclosure.

current_disclosures.section: Note 7 - Cash Equivalents and Marketable Securities
current_disclosures.summary: Beginning in Q2 fiscal year 2025, publicly-held equity securities from non-affiliated entities previously in other assets were reclassified as marketable securities. Net unrealized gains on these securities were $163 million in FY2025, while net realized gains on sold securities were $88 million. Gains for prior years (2023-2024) were not significant.

comparisons.peer_summary: As of December 28, 2024, the Company held non-marketable securities in privately-held companies with an estimated fair value of $468 million, recorded using Level 3 inputs, compared to $155 million in the prior year.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose investments in non-affiliated equity securities and their valuation methods, but they differ significantly in composition and accounting treatment. NVDA's holdings are primarily 'marketable' (publicly traded) equity securities valued at $225 million with readily determinable fair values, where changes in fair value flow through net income. In contrast, AMD held $468 million in 'non-marketable' (private) equity securities valued using Level 3 inputs, with no mention of fair value changes flowing through net income in the same manner, reflecting the illiquid nature of private investments compared to NVDA's liquid public market exposure.

sentences.text: Our investments in non-affiliated entities include marketable equity securities, which are publicly traded, and non-marketable equity securities, which are primarily investments in privately held companies.

Our marketable equity securities have readily determinable fair values and are recorded as long-term other assets on our Consolidated Balance Sheets at fair value with changes in fair value recorded in Other income and expense, net on our Consolidated Statements of Income.
Marketable equity securities totaled $225 million and $11 million as of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, respectively.

As of December 28, 2024 and December 30, 2023, the Company had non-marketable securities in privately-held companies of $468 million and $155 million, respectively, which are recorded at estimated fair value based on Level 3 inputs.
